newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Volkswagen Brazil unit to change head.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen Brazil unit to change head.

text.p: Volkswagen AG's Brazilian subsidiary will name a new president by year-end to replace Pierre Alain-De Schmedt, who is being transferred to Spain, said Jornal do Brasil newspaper.
The firm has not officially announced a replacement yet, but some analysts speculate that De Schmedt will be replaced by Jose Ignacio Lopes de Arriortua, Volkswagen AG's world counsel, it said.

De Schmedt, who is expected to take over Spain's Seat by year's end, came to Brazil in 1991 to assume the presidency of Autolatina, a joint-venture between Ford and Volkswagen which has since been disbanded.
Under his management, Volkswagen doubled the number of its plants to four and started producing trucks, it said.
Volkswagen do Brasil officials were not immediately available to confirm the report.
